Oak planks form the lower shelter walls (milestone requires >= 8 oak_planks placed in wall region)
Spruce planks form the upper shelter walls (milestone requires >= 8 spruce_planks placed in wall region)
Jungle planks are the designated road surface material (milestone requires >= 4 jungle_planks in road corridor)
Road provides navigable access path to reach the distant pyramid for torch placement
Enclosed shelter with oak/spruce walls and door must exist before the creeper can be sealed inside

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. Oak_log blocks are placed at (2-3, 0-2, 1-2) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near them and face their direction to demonstrate discovery.

Uses inventory_has because mining spruce_log drops the item into the player's inventory. The player must break at least one spruce_log block from the grove at (-2 to 0, 0-2, 3-4) and collect the drop.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. Jungle_log blocks are placed at (5-6, 0-2, 0) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near them and face their direction.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron helmet results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must first craft a crafting table from oak planks (2x2 inventory grid), then use 5 iron ingots in the helmet recipe pattern on the 3x3 crafting table grid.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a road requires placing blocks in the road corridor. The task_text specifies jungle planks as the road material. Checks for at least 4 jungle_planks placed in the corridor between shelter and pyramid at (12-16, 0, 12-16).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify wall construction. The shelter foundation is at (8-12, 0, 8-12). Walls must be built at y=1 to y=3 using oak planks (lower) and spruce planks (upper) as specified in task_text. NO door check here — the door is only verified in the trap milestone to avoid sequencing conflicts where the shelter would be sealed before the creeper can enter. Both plank rules must pass (AND logic).

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. The potted_blue_orchid is placed at (9, 0, 13) just south of the shelter foundation. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate discovery.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because lighting up the pyramid requires placing torches on/around the structure at (15-19, 0-3, 15-19). No pre-existing torches in the scene — all must be player-placed from the 16 torches given in inventory. Generous box (14-20, 0-5, 14-20) accounts for torches placed on outer edges.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='mob') to verify the creeper has been pushed from its spawn at (10,1,7) into the shelter interior, AND count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify the door is placed confirming enclosure. The mob detection box (9,0,8)-(11,3,12) deliberately EXCLUDES z=7 (the creeper's spawn position) so this condition is NOT pre-satisfied. The creeper must be pushed at least 1 block south to z>=8. Both rules must pass (AND logic).

scene_description: A compact scene where the player must gather three types of wood (oak, spruce, jungle) to craft tools and build structures. Oak logs near spawn provide planks for a crafting table and shelter lower walls. Spruce logs in a small grove provide planks for shelter upper walls. Jungle logs provide planks for a road to a distant sandstone pyramid. The shelter is just a 5x5 oak plank foundation — the player must construct all walls. A NoAI creeper waits just outside the shelter for trapping. A potted blue orchid sits adjacent to the shelter foundation. The pyramid has no pre-placed torches and must be lit by the player.
task_text: Gather three types of wood: find and harvest oak logs, mine spruce logs, and find jungle logs. Craft oak logs into planks using your inventory grid, then build a crafting table and use it with your iron ingots to craft an iron helmet. Build a road to the pyramid using jungle wood planks. Build a shelter on the foundation using oak planks for the lower walls and spruce planks for the upper walls, then place the door. Find the potted blue orchid near your shelter. Light up the pyramid by placing at least 4 torches on it. Finally, push the creeper into your shelter and seal it inside with the door.
design_notes:
FINAL LAYOUT (all coordinates spawn-relative): 

• SPAWN: Player at (0,0,0) on grass_block surface.
• OAK LOGS: 7 logs at (2-3, 0-2, 1-2). Yields 28 oak_planks. Purpose: crafting table (4) + shelter lower walls (8+) + spare.
• SPRUCE LOGS: 8 logs at (-2 to 0, 0-2, 3-4). Yields 32 spruce_planks. Purpose: shelter upper walls (8+) + spare.
• JUNGLE LOGS: 6 logs at (5-6, 0-2, 0). Yields 24 jungle_planks. Purpose: road surface (4+) + spare.
• SHELTER FOUNDATION: 5x5 oak_planks floor at (8-12, 0, 8-12). NO walls pre-built.
• PYRAMID: Stepped smooth_sandstone at (15-19, 0-3, 15-19). NO pre-placed torches.
• POTTED BLUE ORCHID: At (9, 0, 13) — 1 block south of shelter foundation edge.
• CREEPER: NoAI creeper at (10, 1, 7) — 1 block north of shelter foundation edge (z=8). Must be pushed 1 block south to enter trap detection box.
• ROAD CORRIDOR: Area between (12,0,12) and (16,0,16) where jungle planks should be placed.

PLAYER INVENTORY: 5 iron ingots, 16 torches, 1 oak door, 1 diamond pickaxe. NO free planks, NO cobblestone, NO crafting table.

RESOURCE MATH: 84 total planks available from 21 logs. Minimum needed: 4 (crafting table) + 8 (oak shelter walls) + 8 (spruce shelter walls) + 4 (jungle road) = 24 planks. Surplus: 60 planks. Ample margin for imperfect play.

CRAFTING CHAIN: Mine oak log → craft oak planks (2x2 inventory) → craft crafting table (2x2 inventory) → craft iron helmet (3x3 crafting table). No external crafting table needed to start the chain.

CREEPER MECHANICS: NoAI:1b disables all mob AI including targeting, pathfinding, and fuse ignition. The creeper is completely passive — it won't explode, won't move, and can be safely pushed by walking into it. Player pushes it 1 block south from z=7 to z=8+ to enter the shelter area.
